context: Deduplicate only the independently fixable issue, not merely error-page symptoms.

finding_a.claim: Content generation controls offer actions before their required review state, causing avoidable error navigation.
finding_a.expected: Unavailable steps explain prerequisites and become available after approval.
finding_a.basis: Visible staged evidence/outline/draft workflow and server review requirement.
finding_a.observations: New project showed enabled Generate draft. Click produced Unable to continue / Review the evidence before generating an outline or draft. Back returned to project. After evidence and outline approval, generation succeeded.
finding_a.counterevidence: Server correctly rejects premature calls; error message is accurate; browser Back recovers project; no data loss observed.

finding_b.claim: Research active watches remains enabled when all watches are paused.
finding_b.expected: Explain add/resume requirement and enable after active watch exists.
finding_b.basis: Button says active watches; page promises pause without losing history.
finding_b.observations: Ran watch successfully, then paused sole watch. Button remained enabled. Click navigated to Unable to continue / Add an active watch before running research. Back retained paused watch and saved report.
finding_b.counterevidence: Backend correctly prevents an empty Run; saved report persists. Minor recoverable burden, no data loss.
